en.title: Checking this computer
en.blocked: The installation cannot continue. Nothing was downloaded.
en.gpu: Personal AI English Teacher needs an NVIDIA graphics card (GeForce RTX 20 series or newer, 6 GB of video memory or more). No NVIDIA card was found on this computer (found: {value}).
en.driver_missing: The NVIDIA card {name} has no NVIDIA driver installed. Install the latest driver from nvidia.com/drivers or the NVIDIA app, restart the computer and run the installer again.
en.driver: The NVIDIA driver {value} is too old; version {required} or newer is needed. Update it from nvidia.com/drivers or the NVIDIA app, restart the computer and run the installer again.
en.architecture: The card {name} is too old (CUDA compute capability {value}); {required} or newer is needed, which means GeForce RTX 20 series or newer.
en.vram: The card {name} has {value} of video memory; at least {required} is needed.
en.ram: This computer has {value} of RAM; {required} is recommended. The app may be slow while other programs are open.
en.disk: Drive {name} has {value} free; the installation needs about {required}. Free up space and run the installer again.
en.windows: Windows build {value} is older than {required}. The app is tested on Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11; update Windows if something does not work.
en.step_python: Installing Python {version} for Personal AI English Teacher
en.step_packages: Installing Python packages (about 5 GB; this takes a while the first time)
en.step_models: Downloading the speech models (about 3.2 GB; a broken download continues where it stopped)
en.step_assets: Downloading fonts and the voice detector
en.shortcuts_question: Create shortcuts on the Desktop and in the Start menu? [Y/n]
en.done: Personal AI English Teacher is installed.
en.launching: Starting Personal AI English Teacher. The first-run wizard opens in its window.
en.failed_hint: Fix the cause and run install.cmd again: it continues where it stopped.
en.failed_checksum: a downloaded file does not match its checksum ({what}). It was deleted; run install.cmd again.
en.path_unwritable: Personal AI English Teacher cannot write to {path}. Move the Personal AI English Teacher folder to a folder of your own, for example C:\EnglishTeacher, and run install.cmd again.
en.path_ascii: The folder path {path} has letters that the pronunciation component cannot read, and Windows keeps no short name for it. Move the Personal AI English Teacher folder to a path without accents, for example C:\EnglishTeacher.
en.path_long: The folder path {path} is too long for the Python environment. Move the Personal AI English Teacher folder closer to the drive, for example C:\EnglishTeacher.
en.uninstall_question: Remove Personal AI English Teacher (its Python environment, downloaded tools and shortcuts) from this computer? [y/N]

en.uninstall_data_question: Also delete your data ({path}: sessions, recordings, settings, models) and your API keys? This cannot be undone. [y/N]
en.uninstall_done: Personal AI English Teacher was removed. You can now delete this folder.
en.uninstall_kept: Your data and keys were kept in {path} and the Windows Credential Manager.

es.title: Revisando esta computadora
es.blocked: La instalación no puede continuar. No se descargó nada.
es.warned: La instalación continúa, pero ten en cuenta:
es.gpu: Personal AI English Teacher necesita una tarjeta gráfica NVIDIA (GeForce RTX serie 20 o más reciente, con 6 GB de memoria de video o más). No se encontró ninguna tarjeta NVIDIA en esta computadora (se encontró: {value}).
es.driver_missing: La tarjeta NVIDIA {name} no tiene instalado el controlador de NVIDIA. Instala el controlador más reciente desde nvidia.com/drivers o la aplicación NVIDIA, reinicia la computadora y vuelve a ejecutar el instalador.
es.driver: El controlador de NVIDIA {value} es demasiado antiguo; se necesita la versión {required} o más reciente. Actualízalo desde nvidia.com/drivers o la aplicación NVIDIA, reinicia la computadora y vuelve a ejecutar el instalador.
es.architecture: La tarjeta {name} es demasiado antigua (capacidad de cómputo CUDA {value}); se necesita {required} o más, es decir, GeForce RTX serie 20 o más reciente.
es.vram: La tarjeta {name} tiene {value} de memoria de video; se necesitan al menos {required}.
es.ram: Esta computadora tiene {value} de RAM; se recomiendan {required}. La aplicación puede ir lenta si hay otros programas abiertos.
es.disk: La unidad {name} tiene {value} libres; la instalación necesita unos {required}. Libera espacio y vuelve a ejecutar el instalador.
es.windows: La compilación de Windows {value} es anterior a {required}. La aplicación se prueba en Windows 10 22H2 y Windows 11; actualiza Windows si algo no funciona.
es.step_python: Instalando Python {version} para Personal AI English Teacher
es.step_packages: Instalando los paquetes de Python (unos 5 GB; la primera vez tarda un rato)
es.step_models: Descargando los modelos de voz (unos 3,2 GB; si la descarga se corta, continúa donde se quedó)
es.step_assets: Descargando las fuentes y el detector de voz

es.uninstall_running: Primero se cierra Personal AI English Teacher.
es.uninstall_data_question: ¿Borrar también tus datos ({path}: sesiones, grabaciones, configuración, modelos) y tus claves de API? No se puede deshacer. [s/N]

es.uninstall_kept: Tus datos y claves se conservaron en {path} y en el Administrador de credenciales de Windows.
